setupPage.addTheTargetFirstAnd: List the target in the endpoints file first and verify it. Use DAST_INGEST_TOKEN, set where dast runs, or an API token with the editor role from API tokens.
setupPage.eachEngineSReportsReplace: Each engine's reports replace its own earlier ones. What it stops reporting is fixed; what it reports for the first time is new.
setupPage.theFirstReportOfAn: The first report of an engine for a target adopts what is there and never fails a check.
setupPage.aFindingIsFoundAgain: A finding is found again by rule, page and parameter, not by query string.
setupPage.resultsOutsideTheTargetS: Results outside the target's address are left out, and counted.
setupPage.passwordsCookiesAndTokensIn: Passwords, cookies and tokens in what an engine saw are masked before they are stored.
setupPage.dastDoesNotRunScans: dast does not run scans yet. When it does, an unverified target is never attacked.

agentsPage.title: Agents
agentsPage.description: dast-agent runs ZAP and Nuclei where your applications are, and asks dast for scans. dast never connects to it, and it attacks only targets proven to be yours.
agentsPage.name: Name
agentsPage.noAgentsDetail: Add one, then start it with its command where it can reach your applications.
agentsPage.agentNameHint: Lowercase letters, digits, dots and dashes, such as dc1.
agentsPage.queueDescription: The latest 200 scans and verifications. A job an agent does not finish goes back to the queue, three times at most.
agentsPage.startDescription: Run this where the agent can reach your applications and dast. The token works once, for 7 days, and is not shown again.

authProfiles.title: Logins
authProfiles.noneDetail: Scans see only what a signed-out visitor sees.
